items.title: What can you do with a DAX query? | Zoe Douglas
items.summary: **What can you do with a DAX query? \| Zoe Douglas** Power BI has a query language to get data out of the semantic model -- the DAX query. This is different from DAX formulas you find in calculated columns, tables, and measures. With DAX query view you can quickly use this to understand your data, try out new formulas, and troubleshoot formulas you already have.
